summary: Security Audit #3 retest, covering the change to the push-tap allowlist. Code check: in _layout.tsx, usePushTaps now only calls router.push() when the path matches /^\/(driver|merchant|admin)(\/[\w-]+)*$/. There is no Linking.openURL in the tap path, and it is skipped on web. I ran the regex in node against 25 cases with 0 mismatches. It accepts /driver/drv-1, /driver/drv-5ea5c8f1, /driver, /admin/setup and /admin/routes/rt-1. It rejects https://evil.com, //evil.com, /driver/../x, javascript:alert(1), /driver//evil.com, /driver?x=1, /driver#x, a trailing newline, /drivers, /customer/MD1001, %2e%2e, backslash paths, non-ASCII and the empty string. The backend sends action_url f'/driver/{driver_id}' (push.py:69), which matches the allowlist. Backend: new test_audit3_push_tap_regression.py passes 6/6. GET /api/privacy/officer returns Albert Desjardins / bertdesjardins@hotmail.com. register-push returns 401 with no token, 403 for another user_id, 400 for platform web, and the expected 500 'EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY missing or invalid' for the user's own id. admin/setup returns 401 with no token, 403 for merchants and drivers, and 200 for admin. The iteration 43 suite passes 16/16 when run serially (-n 0). Frontend smoke at 390x844, no page errors and no red screen: the / landing page loads; /privacy shows 'Albert Desjardins, Privacy Officer, DashLocal Inc. · bertdesjardins@hotmail.com' under Contact; admin login lands on /admin (Control Center); the /sign-in/staff Driver toggle and /driver (logged out) show the driver sign-in form. No deprecated Expo packages were found (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch).
action_items: (Optional, low) Cold-start tap: getLastNotificationResponseAsync().then(open) can call router.push before the Stack is mounted, because RootLayout returns a bare View until fonts load. Expo Router may then throw or drop the navigation. Consider deferring until the navigation is ready (for example, run this logic in a child of <Stack>, or gate on `loaded`/useRootNavigationState).

(Optional, test hygiene) The older tests/test_privacy_compliance.py::test_driver_route_hides_phone_and_fee fails because demo drivers have no phipa_consent_given and the driver endpoints return 403 'Accept the privacy & compliance terms'. The test is out of date, not a product bug: the fixture should POST /api/me/consent and then restore the previous state.
critical_code_review_comments: The allowlist is correct and strict. In JS, \w without the u flag is ASCII-only, so '..', '.', '%', ':', '?', '#', '\\' and '//' are all rejected and the URL cannot leave the app.
Cold-start router.push may run before the navigator is mounted (see action_items). This is a reliability point, not a security one.
flaky_tests: test_setup_guide_push_new_driver.py::TestAddDriverAndPush::test_create_login_and_duplicate failed once under -n 2 xdist and passes serially. Likely a shared-state race on the TEST phone +15195550999 with another worker.
seed_data_creation: None. TEST_ drivers were cleaned up (0 left) and demo data is intact (3 drivers).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Push delivery can only be tested in a native build. EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY is a placeholder, so 500 is the expected response. Run suites serially with -n 0 when they share TEST phone numbers. Demo drivers have no consent recorded, so driver-token calls to the route/stop endpoints return 403 until POST /api/me/consent.
